panels.title: 跑步距离 (km)
panels.description: 跑步距离 (km)：原始折线 + 均值虚线（区间AVG）+ 3点移动平均趋势线。均值采用limit(20)采样后map填充，确保水平线渲染。

targets.query:
from(bucket: "training")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "running_distance_km")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")

meanVal = from(bucket: "training")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "running_distance_km")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> mean()
  |> findRecord(fn: (key) => true, idx: 0)

from(bucket: "training")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "running_distance_km")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: meanVal._value, _field: "均值"}))

from(bucket: "training")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "running_distance_km")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> movingAverage(n: 3)
